webtransport-go: Memory Exhaustion Attack due to Buffering of Unknown Capsules

Aliases: CVE-2026-57497

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L

Affected:

  • github.com/quic-go/webtransport-go — fixed in 0.11.1

## Summary An attacker can cause excessive memory allocation in webtransport-go by sending an unknown WebTransport capsule with a large payload. The implementation skips unknown capsules by reading the entire capsule body into memory, instead of draining it without retaining the data. This can lead to memory exhaustion. ## Impact A misbehaving or malicious peer can cause a denial-of-service (DoS) attack against webtransport-go clients or servers by triggering excessive memory allocation, potentially leading to crashes or resource exhaustion. ## Details WebTransport sessions use capsules on the HTTP/3 request stream.
